name: Cloudflare Remote MCP Server Template
description: A deployment template for hosting remote Model Context Protocol servers on Cloudflare Workers using Server-Sent Events (SSE). It enables developers to expose custom tools to MCP-compatible clients like Claude Desktop and Cloudflare AI Playground without requiring authentication.
